calendar.notes: Synthetic equally spaced sessions, not real market observations or a prospective holdout.

costs.notes: Known teaching fee 0.0001 of starting equity per session. No real execution or calibrated costs.

protocol.notes: Controlled simulation: candidates and primary seed fixed before drawing this world. The 0.05 per-session hurdle is an illustrative choice, not a universal economic cutoff.

reference.notes: Exogenous synthetic reference generator, fixed independently of candidate outcomes; not proof of peer independence.
